general_information.name: I THINK IT’S BRIAN… MAYBE THAT’S ENOUGH FOR NOW? I CAN CHECK THE REST IF YOU NEED IT.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly it’s been the drinking to get to sleep, and my mood’s been pretty low. I’ve also been feeling guilty and missing work some.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to cut down on the drinking and be able to sleep without it. And I want to stop feeling like I’m a burden to my family.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Scarborough. It was a difficult home, mostly because of my dad’s drinking.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I left school when I was 18 and started working right away.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’ve been married about 22 years, and it’s still current but pretty strained. We have two adult children.
personal_history.future_goals: I just want to be sober and useful to my family again.
